findings.title: Form lacks consent or privacy notice
findings.remediation: Add a consent and privacy-notice field group at the start of the form covering purpose, voluntary participation and data-use statements.
findings.detail: No consent or privacy-notice field was found in the form.
evidence: no field name or label matched consent keywords (consent, kubali, ridhaa, privacy notice, informed consent, agree to participate)

findings.title: Sensitive category data
findings.remediation: Restrict access to sensitive columns, store them encrypted, aggregate or apply small-cell suppression before sharing, and reconfirm the lawful basis for collecting them.
evidence: sensitive term(s) matched in free text at line 4: art (raw value withheld)
sensitive term(s) matched in free text at line 10: survivor, gbv (raw value withheld)
sensitive term(s) matched in free text at line 11: survivor, gbv (raw value withheld)

findings.title: Consent evidence missing
findings.remediation: Capture an explicit consent record per respondent, retain the signed or verbal-consent evidence, and exclude non-consenting records from analysis and sharing.
evidence: line 4: consent value is not affirmative (recorded as 'No')
line 9: consent value is absent

findings.title: Sensitive fields not encrypted
findings.remediation: Move sensitive questions behind encrypted field types (or server-side encryption) and limit who can export raw submissions.
findings.detail: Field 'hiv_status' holds sensitive data but its type ('text') is not encrypted.
evidence: sensitive field type without encryption; raw submissions would be stored in plaintext

findings.title: Skip pattern violations
findings.remediation: Repair the relevant/skip logic in the form, retrain enumerators, and treat answers to non-applicable questions as missing during analysis.
evidence: line 4: 'anc_facility' must be filled when currently_pregnant == Yes

findings.title: PII in values
findings.remediation: Strip or mask identifiers from free text, move contact details to controlled-access columns, and restrict export permissions to staff who genuinely need them.
evidence: phone number detected at line 6 and masked as '07******78' (raw value withheld)
email address detected at line 6 and masked as 'ja************om' (raw value withheld)
national ID detected at line 8 and masked as '12***67' (raw value withheld)

findings.title: Location precision risk
findings.remediation: Round coordinates to at most 3 decimal places (about 110 m at the equator) or capture location at administrative-area level unless finer precision is essential to the programme.
evidence: line 8: coordinate with 6 decimal places exceeds the 3-decimal precision limit (value withheld)

findings.title: Child data present
findings.remediation: Verify child safeguarding procedures, confirm guardian consent and child assent workflows, and restrict access to records about minors.
evidence: line 7: age=17 indicates a data subject below 18; child safeguarding rules apply

findings.title: GPS field precision
findings.remediation: Capture locations at the coarsest useful precision: trim decimal places on geopoint fields or use administrative-area choice lists instead of raw coordinates.
findings.detail: Location field 'home_location' has no built-in precision limit.
evidence: raw geopoint/geotrace/geoshape capture can identify a household; consider coarse capture or trimmed precision

findings.title: Broken relevant expression
findings.remediation: Fix the relevant expression so every ${field} reference points to an existing field, and test the form in a web client before deployment.
findings.detail: Relevant expression on 'follow_up_notes' references unknown field '$referral_facility'.
evidence: relevant expression references '$referral_facility', which is not a field in this form

findings.title: Duplicate records
